Name: Bun Dau Mam Tom and More
Author: IAMJULIES
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you are playing SDV 1.6.8, have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.8[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14487]Sprites in Detail (SiD)[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod and unzip into Mods folder.
[/list][size=5][b]ABOUT THIS MOD:[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[b][size=4]v1.0.0[/size][/b]
This mod brings the authentic taste of Vietnam straight to your farm with the classic dish [i]Bún đậu mắm tôm[/i]. At the moment, the mod includes:
[list]
[*][b]New Items[/b]: Rice Vermicelli (Bún), Tofu (Đậu phụ), Shrimp Paste (Mắm tôm), and the combined dish [i]Bún đậu mắm tôm[/i].
[*][b]Recipe Access[/b]: The recipe for [i]Bún đậu mắm tôm[/i] can be purchased directly from Gus.
[*][b]Work in Progress[/b]: Recipes for crafting Rice Vermicelli, Tofu, and Shrimp Paste are not yet implemented. Buffs are still placeholders and will be updated to match each item’s unique flavor and role.
[/list]Future updates will expand the cooking experience by adding full recipes for each base ingredient, rebalancing buffs, and making the mod feel even more integrated into the Stardew Valley cooking system.

[b][size=4]v1.1.0[/size][/b]
This update makes [i]Bún đậu mắm tôm[/i] even more authentic!
[list]
[*][b]New Recipes[/b]:
[/list]﻿ ﻿ ﻿Vermicelli ([i]Bún[/i]) recipe – available at Gus.
﻿﻿Shrimp Paste ([i]Mắm tôm[/i]) – craftable in a [i]Preserves Jar[/i].
﻿﻿Fried Tofu ([i]Đậu phụ[/i]) – craftable in a [i]Cheese Press[/i].
[list]
[*][b]Balance Changes[/b]: Adjusted buffs for [i]Bún đậu mắm tôm[/i] to better reflect its hearty nature.
[*][b]Compatibility[/b]: Fully works with [i]Artisan Goods Keep Quality[/i].
[/list]Bring the full street-food experience to Stardew Valley with properly craftable ingredients and improved gameplay integration!

[size=4][b]v1.1.1[/b]
[/size]Add Chinese Translation.

[b][size=4]v1.2.0-beta[/size][/b]
The [i]Vietnamese Cuisine[/i] set expands with the legendary dish [b]Phở[/b]!
[list]
[*][b]New Items & Recipes[/b]:
• [i]Phở[/i] – the iconic noodle soup of Vietnam.• [i]Pho Noodles (Bánh phở)[/i] – fresh flat rice noodles.• [i]Bone Broth (Nước ninh xương)[/i] – slow-simmered base for authentic flavor.• [i]Bone Broth Pot (Nồi ninh xương)[/i] – a new artisan machine for making broth.[*][b]Beta Note[/b]: This release is still in beta as full [b]i18n translation support[/b] isn’t added yet. Planned localization update between [b]September 9–10[/b].
[/list]Enjoy an early taste of Phở while we polish the details!

[b][size=4]v1.2.0[/size][/b]
Add English translation (default.json).

[size=4][b]v1.2.1[/b][/size]
This update continues to refine the [i]Pho expansion[/i] and makes the mod more polished and immersive. You can now fully enjoy Vietnamese cuisine with proper localization, a functional crafting recipe, and more natural progression:
[list]
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Added full support for Vietnamese and Chinese, so players can enjoy the mod in their preferred language.
[*][b]Bone Broth Pot[/b]: Finally craftable! Built from sturdy materials, it represents the essential tool for simmering rich broth.
[*][b]Progression[/b]: Gus will share his [i]Bone Broth Pot Recipe[/i] through mail once you reach 8 hearts of friendship with him, making the unlock feel more rewarding and natural.
[*][b]Polish[/b]: The manifest.json has been updated to reflect version 1.2.1.
[/list]With these changes, the mod feels more complete and connected to the game world.

[b][size=4]v1.2.2[/size][/b]
This update focuses on polish and small improvements to make the Vietnamese cuisine set feel smoother and more alive. The Pho experience is now more refined with fixes and visual upgrades:
[list]
[*][b]Pho Noodles Fixes[/b]: Adjusted and corrected some issues related to [i]Pho Noodles[/i] for better consistency and balance.
[*][b]Bone Broth Pot Animation[/b]: The pot now has a proper simmering animation while in use, making it feel more immersive and lively in your farmhouse.
[/list]These changes don’t add new content, but they make the existing features feel more natural and enjoyable in everyday gameplay.

[b][size=4]v1.3.0-beta[/size][/b]
Version [b]1.3.0-beta[/b] expands the Vietnamese cuisine mod with one of the most iconic dishes: [b]Bún Chả[/b]. Players can now enjoy:
[list]
[*][b]New Dish[/b]: Bún Chả – complete with its essential components (grilled pork patties, minced pork, fish sauce, noodles).
[*][b]New Machines[/b]:
[list]
[*][b]Grinder[/b] – process raw ingredients into minced pork.
[*][b]Grill[/b] – cook minced pork into delicious grilled patties.
[/list][*][b]Cooking System[/b]: Recipes for Bún Chả and its components are now integrated, adding a deeper “farm-to-table” cooking experience.
[*][b]Localization[/b]: This beta version does [b]not include full i18n translations[/b] yet. Translations (Vietnamese, Chinese, etc.) will be fully available in the [b]official 1.3.0 release[/b].
[/list][quote]﻿Credits:
Grinder sprite is based on assets from Cornucopia - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url]﻿ by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MizuJakkaru]MizuJakkaru [/url]﻿and 6480. 
Used under their open asset permission.[/quote][size=4][b]v1.3.0[/b][/size]
This update marks a big step forward for the project. Machines are now not only decorative but also craftable through proper recipes. You can finally build your [b]Grinder[/b] and [b]Grill[/b] with your own hands, giving the kitchen a more authentic upgrade.
In addition, this version comes with [b]full English and Vietnamese translations[/b], so you can enjoy the mod in both languages without missing a single flavor note.
We’ve also made [b]some adjustments to the machine behavior[/b] to make them smoother and more consistent in gameplay. Expect fewer awkward moments and more reliable cooking fun.
On a slightly bittersweet note: sending crafting recipes via mail for BigCraftables doesn’t quite play nicely with the usual [code]"f <NPC> <hearts>"[/code] conditions. Sadly, that means machines can’t be delivered through friendship letters the same way cooking recipes can. Consider it a Stardew quirk – one that left me a little sad, but still determined to keep pushing forward.

[b][size=4]v1.3.1-beta[/size][/b]
This beta update experiments with [b]HD sprites[/b] for some custom objects using the SiD framework.
If you ever felt my items looked a little too "chunky" in 16x16, now they’re sharper and cleaner in higher resolution (still a work-in-progress).
Please note:
[list]
[*]HD sprites are still in testing. Some objects may appear slightly off compared to vanilla assets, but I kinda like that contrast.
[*]Currently, there’s [b]no Chinese (中文) i18n translation[/b]. English and Vietnamese remain fully supported.
[/list]This is a [b]beta build[/b], so feedback is welcome if you notice odd visuals or scaling quirks.

[b][size=4]v1.3.1
[/size][/b]This update makes things look [i]way[/i] sharper — I’ve now added [b]full HD sprites[/b] for all custom objects using the [b]SiD framework[/b].
No more squinting at 16x16 blobs — your kitchen tools and tasty dishes now pop out in detail.
What’s inside:
[list]
[*]Every custom object has been redrawn in higher resolution.
[*]Vanilla-style vibe kept where possible, but with a bit of personal flair — yeah, they might stand out, but that’s the charm.
[*]Fully compatible with the latest version of SMAPI and JSON Assets.
[/list]Translations:
[list]
[*]English ✅
[*]Vietnamese ✅
[*]Chinese (中文) ❌ [i]still not ready, sorry fam.[/i]
[/list]
[b][size=4]v1.4.0: Bun Dau Expansion+[/size][/b]
[b]Bun Dau Expansion+ v1.4.0[/b] brings a fresh twist to the series with new flavors and visuals:
[list]
[*]Added [b]two new dishes[/b] requested by players: [i]Bun Dau with Mayonnaise[/i] and [i]Bun Dau with Salt–Pepper–Lime[/i].
[*]Fully updated [b]HD sprites[/b] for all dishes in the expansion.
[*]Complete [b]English and Vietnamese translations[/b], so both local and international players can enjoy these iconic (and sometimes questionable) Vietnamese dishes.
[/list]This update continues the spirit of Bun Dau Expansion+: a fun, quirky mix of traditional food culture and Stardew Valley charm.[/spoiler]

[size=5][b]CREDIT:[/b][/size]
- Grinder sprite is based on assets from Cornucopia - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24842]Artisan Machines[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2821799]MizuJakkaru[/url] and 6480.
